positions.name: QuantumDBMigrationRationale
positions.frame: What grounds the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB switch — is it presented as a settled commitment, a case being argued, or both at once?
positions.why: All three expressions read in the same direction — a database migration decision framed through quantified proportional gains (10x performance, lower cost) — but the conviction and power reads split within that direction: src-1 and src-3 perform the migration as already-decided (present-progressive 'we're switching', arrow-notation bullet recap with a dated timeline — ratification language, informational/decisional stance), while src-2 supplies the rational-persuasion justification (flat, unhedged quantified claims) that a decision, rather than argues for one. The set holds that tension: declaration-recap bracketing a claim, unified by the shared market-pricing/cost-benefit framing (10x query performance, lower licensing cost) and openness-to-change/competence value appeal running through all three.
